original_defect.impact: Very short document fragments could match materially longer TOC headings, become anchors, and pollute page-offset consensus.

root_cause: Containment and fuzzy text scores were allowed to receive layout boosts before lexical trust was established.
Anchor output did not explicitly distinguish trusted matches from rejected candidates.
Expected-title and candidate-title token coverage and length compatibility were not enforced.

match_tiers.C: strong fuzzy match with lexical, token-coverage, and length-ratio thresholds
match_tiers.D: substantial containment with coverage and length safeguards

rejected_by_adversarial_tests.reason: short fragment and insufficient token coverage
short fragment and insufficient token coverage
section marker and insufficient token coverage

adversarial_regressions: TO cannot anchor Statement by Directors
(e) cannot anchor Notes to the Financial Statements
layout position cannot rescue an untrusted lexical candidate
trusted and rejected evidence remains inspectable
decision: Anchor eligibility now depends on trustworthy lexical evidence before geometry or layout scoring. Rejected candidates cannot vote in alignment consensus or establish section boundaries.
